source.title: Bioelectric signaling regulates head and organ size during planarian regeneration.

injury: cuts just anterior and just posterior to the pharynx

intervention.timing: worms injected days 1-3, cut on day 8 or 14
intervention.description: Smed-H,K-ATPase dsRNA injected into worms, then pharynx fragments cut and regenerated

notes: Percentages given, n stated only as n>=125 so n_total null. 'other' = proportionally very tiny (shrunken) heads with oversized pharynx. Remaining 4.2% not described in paper. Intended type is ion_channel_knockdown (RNAi) but validator does not accept it.
